# Code Review Report

## Review Summary

This branch adds the new analytical review family pieces for character voice critique, raw chapter RAG retrieval, and a new `consistency-checker` subagent wired into the orchestrator. The Python and TypeScript tool changes look narrowly scoped and are backed by unit tests, but the agent-layer integration has two merge-blocking runtime defects: the new subagent is not registered for dispatch, and its wiki-search instructions use an invalid tool contract.

**Files Reviewed:** 15  
**Findings:** 2 Critical, 1 Warning, 1 Suggestion

## Findings

### Critical Findings

[C-01] New `consistency-checker` subagent is not registered or allowed for orchestrator dispatch
Category: Correctness
Severity: Critical
File: opencode.json
Lines: 20-39
Description: The PR adds a new subagent file and updates the orchestrator instructions to dispatch `consistency-checker` in Phase 7e and again during post-processing, but `opencode.json` still defines only five allowed task targets for `story-orchestrator` and has no `consistency-checker` entry in the top-level `agent` block. In OpenCode, missing registration and missing allow-list entries prevent dispatch at runtime, so the new Phase 7e path will fail even though the orchestrator documentation now treats it as implemented.
Suggestion: Add a top-level `agent.consistency-checker` entry to `opencode.json` and allow it under `agent.story-orchestrator.permission.task`. Re-check any other currently dispatched subagents that are also absent from the allow-list, but at minimum this PR must register the new subagent it introduces.

[C-02] `consistency-checker` calls `wiki-search` with unsupported operation and parameter names
Category: Correctness
Severity: Critical
File: .opencode/agents/consistency-checker.md
Lines: 56-60
Description: Step 2 instructs the agent to call `wiki-search` with `operation: "search"` and `limit: 3`. The actual tool contract only accepts `operation` values `semantic` or `metadata` in both the TypeScript wrapper and Python backend, and the count parameter is named `nResults`, not `limit` ([.opencode/tools/wiki-search.ts](.opencode/tools/wiki-search.ts), [src/tools/wiki_search.py](src/tools/wiki_search.py)). As written, the first semantic analysis call will be rejected by the wrapper or backend instead of returning wiki state.
Suggestion: Update the agent instructions to use `operation: "semantic"` and `nResults: 3`, then verify all examples and surrounding prose use the same contract.

### Warning Findings

[W-01] Companion story-pipeline skill was not updated after adding the new orchestrator subagent
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: .opencode/skills/story-pipeline/SKILL.md
Lines: 146-190
Description: The orchestrator now documents ten dispatchable subagents and replaces Phase 7e wiki lint with `consistency-checker`, but the companion skill still says Phase 7e is `wiki-lint`, still claims the pipeline uses nine subagents, and still states that only nine subagents may be dispatched. This is exactly the companion-sync drift the shared review process calls out, and it leaves an authoritative project document contradicting the new orchestrator contract.
Suggestion: Update the Phase 7 table, the ASCII flow, the subagent table, and the “only nine subagents” constraint sentence so the skill matches the new orchestrator behavior.

### Suggestions

[S-01] Feature documentation describes the wrong consistency-report contract
Category: Documentation
Severity: Suggestion
File: docs/features/story-orchestrator.md
Lines: 238-246
Description: The new `consistency-checker` feature section says the returned report contains an `is_blocking` flag and then ties re-dispatch to `requires_post_processing`. The actual agent contract returns `has_critical_findings`, and `requires_post_processing` belongs to the `quality-reviewer` result, not the consistency report. This does not break runtime behavior directly, but it misstates the integration contract for future maintainers.
Suggestion: Rewrite this paragraph to match the actual return schema from `.opencode/agents/consistency-checker.md` and keep the quality-reviewer post-processing flag described in the Phase 7f section only.

## Overall Assessment

Not ready for merge. The core tool-layer additions for `raw-chapter` and `character-voice` look reasonable, but the new agent-layer integration is currently non-functional because the orchestrator cannot legally dispatch the new subagent and, even if it could, the subagent’s semantic wiki search step uses an invalid tool call contract. After those blockers are fixed, the remaining work is mostly companion-documentation cleanup.
